senses.gloss: दृं॑हण n. making firm, fastening, strengthening, AV. vi, 136, 1 (cf. केश-द्˚)
दृं˚हित॑ mfn. (or दृहित, Pāṇ. vii, 2, 20, Sch.) made firm, fortified
दृं˚हितृ॑ m. strengthener, fortifier, ib.; TBr.
दृन् ind. an interjection (prob. made to explain दृन्भू), L.
दृन्फू m. a kind of snake, Uṇ. i, 93, Sch. (v.l. दृम्फू).
दृन्भू m. (Pāṇ. vi, 4, 84, Vārtt. 1, Pat.) a thunderbolt, L.
